rawMessage: Publish and read back the human Drive workbook separately from the complete semantic Markdown source in NotebookLM. Google Sheets is not a supported NotebookLM Drive source. A recent upload timestamp does not refresh old vendor observations.

Verify exact-product replacement content, indexing and source-restricted grounded canary, then commit trust metadata before removing only managed stale catalog snapshots. Preserve QuickSpecs, separate learnings, shared enclosure/fabric sources and unrelated documents. Inventory absence is not authority to remove another product source.

Preserve retrieved cloud learning documents locally with their source IDs. Treat prose claims as candidates pending dated vendor evidence; resolve contradictions before promoting hardware dependencies. Conflicting quantity claims require dated evidence for this exact product and selector state.

ruleUpdate: 6x HPE Synergy Dual Slot Power Supply Adapters (P44074-B21) expand a Synergy 12000 Frame (P51174-B21) from 6 physical PSU bays to 12x HPE 1800W-2200W Flex Slot Titanium PSUs (P44712-B21) per frame (verified across 2-frame 24-PSU UCID 5158592304-01 and 3-frame 36-PSU UCID 5158590124-02 OCA builds). Multi-frame roles are encoded inside sequential frames Synergy 12000 Frame #1/#2/#3 via 859493-B21 (Master1 FIO + Composer2 872957-B21), 859494-B22 (Master2 FIO + Composer2), and Satellite frames (no Master FIO / no Composer2).
